title: Model-specific thinking allowance is copied onto the actor

source.evidence_note: Verified native message, patch, result, and recovery anchors; private normalized capture retained locally.

horizon.earlier_event: User narrows allowance to teacher/student models at source-A L414.
horizon.later_decision: Actor setting enabled by patch at L471.
horizon.intervening_work: Read existing policy and reorganize plan/config/task pairs.
horizon.mechanism: The rule was carried from model components to the actor within minutes, not across a demonstrated long horizon. The assistant correctly interpreted the scope before changing it. No reset or compaction appears in the measured interval. This supports a component-scope mistake, not a causal forgetting claim. Runtime actor execution with the wrong setting is not observed.

failure.expected_behavior: Enable only teacher/student models, preserving actor policy.
failure.observed_behavior: A user narrowed a thinking allowance to teacher SFT and student OPD/GRPO models. The agent initially restated the correct scope, then enabled actor thinking as well, changed the validator to accept it, and reported completion. After the user corrected the scope, the agent restored the actor restriction.
failure.target_predicate: Actor thinking is enabled after the later model-scoped request.
